flavor: “我敢发誓我们之前来过这儿……”
real_text: Uses (4 secrets). [action] Spend 1 secret: Investigate ([intellect]). Investigate a revealed connecting location. You get +1 [intellect] for this investigation. If you succeed, you may exhaust Local Map to move to that location.

name: 放大镜
text:
快速。
你调查时得到+1[intellect]。
flavor: 透镜映照出平时看不见的世界，揭示的一切你却并不想看见。
real_text:
Fast.
You get +1 [intellect] while investigating.

name: 言辞锐利
text:
[fast]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[intellect](如果是调查或谈判，改为+2[intellect])。
[fast]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[willpower](如果是调查或谈判，改为+2[willpower])。
real_text:
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [intellect] for this skill test (+2 [intellect] instead if this is an investigation or parley).
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [willpower] for this skill test (+2 [willpower] instead if this is an investigation or parley).

name: 收集情报
text:
快速。在敌人进入你的地点时打出。
抽取2张卡牌。
flavor: 你离得越近，就了解得越多。
real_text:
Fast. Play when an enemy enters your location.
Draw 2 cards.

name: 销声匿迹
text: 躲避([agility])。你每控制1个线索，本次躲避得到+1[agility](最多+3)。如果你检定成功，你可以和与你交战的每个敌人解除交战，并移动到一个已揭示的连接地点。
real_text: Evade ([agility]). You get +1 [agility] for this evasion for each clue you control (to a maximum of +3). If you succeed, you may disengage from each enemy engaged with you and move to a revealed connecting location.

name: 专业的直觉
text:
快速。只能在你回合期间打出。
发现你所在地点的1个线索。
real_text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Discover 1 clue at your location.

name: 推理
text: 如果调查一个地点时本技能检定成功，额外发现该地点的1个线索。
flavor: 更大的秘密中一点小小碎片。
real_text: If this skill test is successful while investigating a location, discover 1 additional clue at that location.

name: 神奇魔典
text:
使用(4秘密)。
[fast]你的回合期间，花费1或2秘密并横置[神奇魔典]：查找你牌库顶3张卡牌(如果你花费了2秘密，改为查找6张卡牌)，找出一张卡牌并将其抽取。如果查找的卡牌中有弱点，也将其全部抽取。混洗你的牌库。
real_text:
Uses (4 secrets).
[fast] During your turn, spend 1 or 2 secrets and exhaust Mysterious Grimoire: Search the top 3 cards (or 6 cards instead if you spent 2 secrets) of your deck for a card and draw it. If 1 or more weaknesses are among the searched cards, draw them as well. Shuffle your deck.

name: 销声匿迹
text: 躲避([agility])。你每控制1个线索，本次躲避得到+2[agility](最多+6)。如果你检定成功，你可以和与你交战的每个敌人解除交战，并移动到一个已揭示的连接地点。
real_text: Evade ([agility]). You get +2 [agility] for this evasion for each clue you control (to a maximum of +6). If you succeed, you may disengage from each enemy engaged with you and move to a revealed connecting location.

name: 苦心钻研
text:
永久。
每场游戏开始时，你的起始手牌中额外有一张卡牌。
flavor: “那晚剩下的时光我们都在亮堂堂的书法里，焦急地讨论下一步的行动。”<cite>H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《壁中恶鼠》</cite>
real_text:
Permanent.
You begin each game with 1 additional card in your opening hand.

name: 狂野知识
text: 揭示你牌库顶的5张卡牌(如果你控制至少2个线索，改为8张卡牌)。从中抽取3张，将其余卡牌以任意顺序放到你的牌库顶和/或牌库底。
real_text: Reveal the top 5 cards of your deck (8 cards instead if you control 2 or more clues). Draw 3 of them and place the rest of those cards on the top and/or bottom of your deck in any order.

name: 幸运烟盒
text: [reaction]你在一次技能检定中成功且超过难度2点或更多后，横置幸运烟盒：抽取1张卡牌。
flavor: “其实没那么幸运，就只是想抽根烟。”
real_text: [reaction] After you succeed at a skill test by 2 or more, exhaust Lucky Cigarette Case: Draw 1 card.

name: M1903击锤内置式手枪
traits: 道具. 武器. 枪械.
text: 使用(4子弹)。 [action]花费1子弹：攻击([agility])。如果对象敌人处于横置状态：本次攻击造成伤害+1。
real_text: Uses (4 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight ([agility]). If the targeted enemy is exhausted, this attack deals +1 damage.

name: 奥利维尔·毕晓普
traits: 盟友. 罪犯. 社会名流.
text:
你得到+1[agility]。
[fast]你的回合期间，横置[奥利维尔·毕晓普]：移动到一个连接地点。
flavor: “那我就暂且……帮你一把。”
real_text:
You get +1 [agility].
[fast] During your turn, exhaust Olivier Bishop: Move to a connecting location.

name: 三寸之舌
text:
[fast]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[intellect](如果是躲避或谈判，改为+2[intellect])。
[fast]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[agility](如果是躲避或谈判，改为+2[agility])。
real_text:
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [intellect] for this skill test (+2 [intellect] instead if this is an evasion or parley).
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [agility] for this skill test (+2 [agility] instead if this is an evasion or parley).

name: 妙手空空
text:
每位调查员仅限1张。
[reaction]你成功躲避敌人后，横置[妙手空空]：获得1资源。
flavor: 比小孩儿进了糖果店还可怕。
real_text:
Limit 1 per investigator.
[reaction] After you successfully evade an enemy, exhaust Sticky Fingers: Gain 1 resource.

name: 扒手行窃工具
traits: 道具. 工具. 违法.
text: 使用(6补给)。 [action]花费1补给：调查([intellect]或[agility])。如果你检定成功，获得1资源。
flavor: “你问我为什么要带着这些？不如说我为什么不带着这些？”
real_text: Uses (6 supplies). [action] Spend 1 supply: Investigate. You may use [agility] instead of [intellect] for this investigation. If you succeed, gain 1 resource.

name: 破门而入
text: 调查([intellect])。本次调查将你的[agility]加入你的[intellect]。如果你检定成功且超过难度至少2点，你可以自动躲避本地点的一个敌人。本行动不会引起趁乱攻击。
flavor: 好过入门再破。
real_text: Investigate. Add your [agility] value to your skill value for this investigation. If you succeed by 2 or more, you may automatically evade an enemy at this location. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: 血腥狂欢
text: 谈判。查找遭遇牌库顶9张卡牌，找出一个非[[精英]]敌人，将其抽取，获得等于该敌人印刷生命值的资源。混洗遭遇牌库。
flavor: 声名无价……吗？
real_text: Parley. Search the top 9 cards of the encounter deck for a non-[[Elite]] enemy, draw it, and gain resources equal to that enemy's printed health. Shuffle the encounter deck.

name: 变戏法
text:
快速。只能在你的回合期间打出。
从你的手牌中打出一张[[道具]]支援，其费用减2。在你的回合结束时，将你控制的一张[[道具]]支援返回你的手牌。
flavor: “现在它在你眼前。现在它又不见了。”
real_text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Play an [[Item]] asset from your hand, reducing its cost by 2. When your turn ends, return an [[Item]] asset you control to your hand.

name: 视线盲区
text:
每次技能检定最多投入1张。
如果本次检定成功且超过难度至少2点，执行检定的调查员可以与每个敌人解除交战并移动到一个已揭示的连接地点。
real_text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
If this test is successful by 2 or more, the performing investigator may disengage from each enemy and move to a revealed connecting location.

name: 妙手空空
text:
快速。每位调查员仅限1张。
[reaction]你成功躲避敌人后，横置[妙手空空]：获得1资源。
flavor: 比小孩儿进了糖果店还可怕。
real_text:
Fast. Limit 1 per investigator.
[reaction] After you successfully evade an enemy, exhaust Sticky Fingers: Gain 1 resource.

name: 致胜一击
text: 攻击([combat])。你本次攻击得到+2[combat]并且造成伤害+1。如果本次攻击击败了敌人，获得5资源。
flavor: 别忘了翻翻口袋。
real_text: Fight ([combat]). You get +2 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack. If this attack defeats an enemy, gain 5 resources.

name: 干一天活计拿一天钱
text:
永久。
你每场游戏开始拥有额外2资源。
flavor: 你很久以前就忘记了什么才是最重要的。
real_text:
Permanent.
You begin each game with 2 additional resources.

name: 视线盲区
text:
每次技能检定最多投入1张。
如果本次检定成功且超过难度至少1点，执行检定的调查员可以与每个敌人解除交战并移动到一个已揭示地点，该地点与其所在地点连接次数不超过2。
real_text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
If this test is successful by 1 or more, the performing investigator may disengage from each enemy and move to a revealed location up to 2 connections away.

name: 共鸣长袍
traits: 道具. 服装. 炼金.
text: [reaction]在恐惧放置到[共鸣长袍]时，将其横置：对你所在地点的一个敌人造成1点伤害。
flavor: “以太三，丹砂二，蛋白石或矿石者斤半取自高峰。”<cite>炼金法式，VIII部分，约1660年</cite>
real_text: [reaction] When horror is placed on Cloak of Resonance, exhaust it: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location.

name: 宇宙烈焰
text: 使用(3充能)。 [action]：攻击([willpower])。如果你检定成功，你可以花费1充能以使本次攻击造成伤害+1。如果你本次检定期间揭示了[skull]标记，移除[宇宙烈焰]的1充能(如果你不能这么做，受到1点伤害并弃掉本卡牌)。
real_text: Uses (3 charges). [action]: Fight ([willpower]). If you succeed, you may spend 1 charge to deal +1 damage for this attack. If you reveal a [skull] token during this test, remove 1 charge from Cosmic Flame (if you cannot, take 1 damage and discard this card).

name: 吉姆·卡尔弗
text:
你得到+1[willpower]。
[reaction]你受到伤害和/或恐惧后，横置[吉姆·卡尔弗]：抽取1张卡牌。
flavor:
“你也看得见这些家伙？
他们真的很难让人习惯。”
real_text:
You get +1 [willpower].
[reaction] After you take damage and/or horror, exhaust Jim Culver: Draw 1 card.

name: 幸运符
traits: 道具. 守护. 祝福.
text: 使用(4充能)。 [fast]花费1充能并横置[幸运符]：将1点伤害或1点恐惧从你所在地点的一张卡牌上移动到你控制的一张(有生命值或神智值的)卡牌上。
real_text: Uses (4 charges). [fast] Spend 1 charge and exhaust Lucky Charm: Move 1 damage or 1 horror from a card at your location to a card you control (with a health or sanity value).

name: 通灵视觉
text: 使用(3充能)。 [action]：调查([willpower])。如果你检定成功，你可以花费1充能以发现你所在地点额外1个线索。如果你本次检定期间揭示了[cultist]标记，移除[通灵视觉]的1充能(如果你不能这么做，受到1点恐惧并弃掉本卡牌)。
real_text: Uses (3 charges). [action]: Investigate ([willpower]). If you succeed, you may spend 1 charge to discover 1 additional clue at your location. If you reveal a [cultist] token during this test, remove 1 charge from Second Sight (if you cannot, take 1 horror and discard this card).

name: 灵感敏锐
text:
[fast]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1 [willpower](如果是[[法术]]或[[仪式]]卡牌上的检定，改为+2[willpower])。
[fast]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1 [combat](如果是[[法术]]或[[仪式]]卡牌上的检定，改为+2[combat])。
real_text:
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [willpower] for this skill test (+2 [willpower] instead if this test is on a [[Spell]] or [[Ritual]] card).
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [combat] for this skill test (+2 [combat] instead if this test is on a [[Spell]] or [[Ritual]] card).

name: 危险预感
text: 快速。可在任何[fast]时间段期间打出。 将[危险预感]放置入场，从混乱袋中随机封印一个混乱标记在[危险预感]上。 强制 - 在一个混乱标记将要从混乱袋中揭示时：改为结算封印在此的标记，如同刚刚从混乱袋中揭示该标记。然后，释放该标记并弃掉[危险预感]。
real_text: Fast. Play during any [fast] player window. Put Premonition into play, reveal a random chaos token from the chaos bag, and seal it on Premonition. Forced - When a chaos token would be revealed from the chaos bag: Resolve the token sealed here as if it were just revealed from the chaos bag, instead. Then, discard Premonition.

name: 守护结界
text:
快速。在你抽取一张非弱点的诡计卡牌时打出。
取消该卡牌的显现效果并受到1点恐惧。
real_text:
Fast. Play when you draw a non-weakness treachery card.
Cancel that card's revelation effect. Then, take 1 horror.

name: 宇宙意志
text: 在你控制的一张玩家卡牌上放置1个毁灭标记。然后，发现你所在地点的1个线索和另一个已揭示地点的1个线索。
flavor:
宇宙中，万物归一。
虚空中，万物皆无。
real_text: Place 1 doom on a player card you control. Then, discover 1 clue at your location and 1 clue at another revealed location.

name: 灵魂链接
text: 作为投入[灵魂链接]的额外费用，受到1点恐惧。
flavor: 因远古之力我得重生。
real_text: As an additional cost to commit Soul Link, take 1 horror.

name: 西勒诺斯面具
traits: 道具. 面具. 遗物. 诅咒萦绕.
text:
使用(3充能)。
[reaction]在你将要揭示一个混乱标记时，花费1充能：额外揭示1个标记。选择其中1个标记结算，并忽略另一个。如果你结算了带有符号的标记，受到1点恐惧。
real_text:
Uses (3 charges).
[reaction] When you would reveal a chaos token, spend 1 charge: Reveal 1 additional token. Choose 1 of those tokens to resolve and ignore the other. If you resolved a token with a symbol, take 1 horror.

name: 无所畏惧
text: 如果本次技能检定成功，治愈1点恐惧(如果检定成功且超过难度2点或更多，则改为治愈2点恐惧)。
flavor: 只有在黑暗面前站稳脚步，才能活着看到明天的太阳。
real_text: If this skill test is successful, heal 1 horror (2 horror instead if it succeeds by 2 or more).

name: 俄洛寇斯的预言
text: 调查([intellect])。本次调查将你的[willpower]加入你的[intellect]。如果你检定成功，发现你所在地点额外1个线索。如果你检定成功，且本次检定期间揭示了带有符号的标记，你可以弃掉任意调查员威胁区域的一张[[恐怖]]或[[巫术]]诡计。
real_text: Investigate ([intellect]). Add your [willpower] to your [intellect] for this investigation. If you succeed, discover 1 additional clue at your location. If you succeed and a token with a symbol was revealed during this test, you may discard a [[Terror]] or [[Hex]] treachery from any investigator's threat area.

name: 宇宙烈焰
text: 使用(4充能)。 [action]：攻击([willpower])。你本次攻击得到+2[willpower]并且造成伤害+1。如果你检定成功，你可以花费1充能以对你所在地点的一个敌人造成1点伤害。如果你本次检定期间揭示了[skull]标记，移除[宇宙烈焰]的1充能(如果你不能这么做，受到1点伤害并弃掉本卡牌)。
real_text: Uses (4 charges). [action]: Fight ([willpower]). You get +2 [willpower] and deal +1 damage for this attack. If you succeed, you may spend 1 charge to deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location. If you reveal a [skull] token during this test, remove 1 charge from Cosmic Flame (if you cannot, take 1 damage and discard this card).

name: 阿列克谢·萨布罗夫
text: [reaction]在你的回合开始时：治愈[阿列克谢·萨布罗夫]的1点伤害或1点恐惧。
flavor: “我受过更重的伤，伙计。”
real_text: [reaction] When your turn begins: Heal 1 damage or 1 horror from Aleksey Saburov.

name: 绷带
text:
使用(3补给)。如果[绷带]上没有补给，将其弃掉。
[reaction]你所在地点的调查员或[[盟友]]支援受到伤害后，花费1补给：治愈该卡牌的1点伤害。
real_text:
Uses (3 supplies). If Bandages has no supplies, discard it.
[reaction] After an investigator or [[Ally]] asset at your location takes 1 or more damage, spend 1 supply: Heal 1 damage from that card.

name: 猎人直觉
text:
每位调查员仅限1张。使用(3补给)。如果[猎人直觉]上没有补给，将其弃掉。
[reaction]你与敌人交战后，花费1补给并横置[猎人直觉]：将一张等级0的事件从你的弃牌堆加入你的手牌。
real_text:
Limit 1 per investigator. Uses (3 supplies). If there are no supplies on Hunter's Instinct, discard it.
[reaction] After you engage an enemy, spend 1 supply and exhaust Hunter's Instinct: Add a level 0 event in your discard pile to your hand.

name: 连体服
text: [fast]你的回合期间，弃掉[连体服]：选择你弃牌堆的一张[[工具]]或[[武器]]支援，将其加入你的手牌。
flavor: 这衣服的口袋深处总能找到你以为彻底弄丢了的东西。
real_text: [fast] During your turn, discard Jumpsuit: Choose a [[Tool]] or [[Weapon]] asset in your discard pile and add it to your hand.

name: 镇静自若
text:
[fast]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[willpower](如果是冒险卡牌上的检定，改为+2[willpower])。
[fast]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[agility](如果是冒险卡牌上的检定，改为+2[agility])。
real_text:
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [willpower] for this skill test (+2 [willpower] instead if this test is on a scenario card).
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [agility] for this skill test (+2 [agility] instead if this test is on a scenario card).

name: 切肉刀
traits: 道具. 武器. 近战.
text: [action]：攻击([combat])。你本次攻击得到+1[combat](如果你剩余神智值不超过3，改为+2[combat])。如果本次攻击击败了敌人，你可以治愈1点恐惧。 [reaction]在你触发上述[action]能力时，受到1点恐惧：本次攻击造成伤害+1。
real_text: [action]: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack (+2 [combat] instead if you have 3 or fewer remaining sanity). If this attack defeats an enemy, you may heal 1 horror. As an additional cost to initiate this ability, you may take 1 horror to have this attack deal +1 damage.

name: “看看我发现了什么！”
text:
快速。你调查时，技能检定失败且低于难度2点及以内后打出。
发现你所在地点的2个线索。
flavor: “哇，来看看这个……”
real_text:
Fast. Play after you fail a skill test by 2 or less while investigating.
Discover 2 clues in your location.

name: “滚开！”
text: 躲避([agility])。如果你检定成功，对躲避的敌人造成1点伤害。如果你检定失败，当你的回合结束时，将[“滚开！”]返回你的手牌。
real_text: Evade ([agility]). If you succeed, deal 1 damage to the evaded enemy. If you fail, return "Shove off!" to your hand at the end of your turn.

name: 灵活脱身
text: 如果躲避非[[精英]]敌人时本次技能检定成功，该敌人在下一个补给阶段期间不重整。
real_text: If this skill test is successful while evading a non-[[Elite]] enemy, that enemy does not ready during the next upkeep phase.

name: 及时干预
text:
每次技能检定最多投入1张。
你执行的技能检定期间，你可以在揭示混乱标记后从你的手牌投入[及时干预]。
real_text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
You may commit Timely Intervention from your hand after revealing chaos tokens during a skill test you are performing.

name: 苦苦支撑
